title: Specify rope–rope system modes
scope: Define self-contact, segment contact and attachments; retain unsupported capability states until implementation.
acceptance: Separate self and inter-system behavior with measurable physical criteria.
Split missing operators and their public-API qualification into new leaf tasks.
evidence: PASS: docs/INTERACTION-MODES.md defines the API 0.2 node-only self-contact limit, future rope-capsule swept segment contact, friction, conservation, stretch and endpoint-attachment behavior.
PASS: P1-31 audits the existing advertised record; P1-32 through P1-38 separate typed API state, candidate generation, self/pair solves, attachment, scheduling and qualification.
PASS: python3 tools/reference/build.py --check-generated; public headers and generated specification remain consistent.
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p 'test_*.py'; 19 roadmap/lease tests passed.
PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations -R '(generated-api-check|interaction-capability|graph-validation)' --output-on-failure; 3/3 passed and new rope-capsule/pair records remain unadvertised.
REVIEW: the existing endpoint-native self record claims sampled-node exclusion only; continuous segments, self friction, rope-pair contact and rope-rope attachment remain unsupported.
